sourceTiers.name: discovery_only_secondary
sourceTiers.restriction: May discover sources or context but cannot alone support a decisive trajectory claim.

deepAnchorMinimumBundle: at least one T0 source where reasonably accessible; if unavailable, document why
at least one independent T1 authoritative retrospective
at least one T2 quantitative/historical synthesis or equivalent adoption/performance evidence
at least one source on serious rival/failure/alternative or explicit evidence that no meaningful rival existed
at least two independent institutions/source lineages for decisive claims
breadthMinimumBundle: at least one T0 or T1 source
at least one independent T1 or T2 source
canonicalDiscoveryPools: NobelPrize.org full prize archive from 1901 onward
IEEE Milestones and Engineering & Technology History Wiki
Smithsonian National Museum of American History invention/innovation archives
Library of Congress manuscript and technology-history collections
citationRule: Store exact URL/identifier, source type, publication/event date, accessed date, claim supported, quoted locator/page where available, and whether the source is contemporaneous or retrospective.
disputeRule: Priority disputes and contested interpretations are represented as competing Claims with source binding, never flattened into one authoritative inventor narrative.
